name: og-04-alt-endogenous-boundary
title: The Endogenous Boundary
question: Can a protocell boundary form from the campaign's own reduced-carbon chemistry - an amphiphile synthesized from acetate + formate that clears the critical aggregation concentration - rather than from an injected amphiphile pool, and is its formation caused by that synthesis?
hypothesis: When acetate + formate condense to an amphiphile that clears the critical aggregation concentration under vesicle-favourable (alkaline, saline) conditions, a viable boundary forms and a new individual appears in the agents map by an _add structural rewrite; with amphiphile synthesis ablated no individual forms, so boundary formation is caused by the endogenous chemistry.
objective: Drive AmphiphileSynthesisProcess from a dissolved acetate+formate pool into the boundary face (single_chain | mixed | thioester_aminothiol); gate that a BoundaryFormationStep _add produces agents 0 -> >=1 in the favorable arm and 0 in the synthesis-ablated control, with the RewriteLedger confirming the rewrite conserves matter.
proposed_mechanisms: H+: the boundary is built from the campaign's own carbon chemistry, not an added amphiphile
structural-rewrite individuation (_add on the agents map) rather than a continuous field
proposed_models_methods: boundary face (Jordan-2019 mixed-amphiphile vesicle; thioester/aminothiol alternative)

conditions.name: rewrite_mass_balance
conditions.expr: rewrite_residual_max == 0 (the _add moves matter localized -> individual, conserved)

behavior_tests.name: boundary-forms-from-chemistry
behavior_tests.description: A new individual appears in the agents map (0 -> >=1) when amphiphile is synthesised from acetate+formate and clears cac; with synthesis ablated (k_synth -> 0) the amphiphile stays below cac and NO individual forms.

measure.detail: favorable forms individuals (n_agents>=1) AND synthesis-ablated forms none; from artifacts/endogenous_boundary_report.json

pass_if.detail: boundary caused by the endogenous chemistry — forms in the favorable arm, not in the synthesis-ablated control

behavior_tests.name: rewrite-conserves-matter
behavior_tests.description: Every _add boundary-formation rewrite conserves matter — the parcel withdrawn from the localized pool exactly equals the new individual's internal amounts (rewrite_ok).

measure.detail: min over steps of the RewriteLedger conservation flag; from artifacts/endogenous_boundary_report.json

literature_anchors.relevance: C10-C15 single-chain amphiphiles + co-surfactant form vesicles pH ~6.5 to >12 at seawater salinity — alkaline hydrothermal conditions favour protocell assembly.

baseline.name: Favorable — endogenous amphiphile synthesis forms the boundary

claim: When acetate and formate condense into an amphiphile under alkaline, saline conditions it clears the critical aggregation concentration, and a new individual appears in the agents map through a matter-conserving structural rewrite. Ablating the synthesis leaves the amphiphile below threshold and no individual forms, so boundary formation is caused by the endogenous chemistry rather than an added amphiphile. What remains assumed is the condensation rate itself (k_synth), an inferred value with no direct prebiotic measurement, swept over a wide prior.

findings.statement: The boundary forms from acetate+formate-derived amphiphile; with synthesis ablated it does not — boundary formation is caused by the endogenous chemistry.

limitations: The amphiphile synthesis rate (k_synth) is an inferred condensation rate with no direct prebiotic measurement (vg-data provenance hypothetical, wide prior).
